Moments that altered my brain chemistry in the last 5 years since founding TALA, a dump to celebrate TALA officially turning 5 (!!) 🤠

I would go on a lil rant about how it feels like just yesterday but that would be a lie, it feels like 73 years x

I’ll be honest that there was a lot of pressure on this year - our plans were (and are) huge, elevating each element of our creative output, attempting to launch into totally new categories, as well as entering the world of physical retail!

At times, maybe this year more than ever, it has felt like running through quicksand, but i’m a firm believer that to *do* hard things you have to go *through* hard things, and I really couldn’t be prouder of what the team has created from their incredibly hard work

I could tell you that we nearly doubled in revenue again with only 10 new team members and remained profitable (which we did 🤠), but here are some things I care much much more about:

since tala turned 4:

👹 every since point of growth we’ve had, we had without compromising our customer service and delivery track record - our first response time HALVED 🏆 to TWO!! HOURS!! and we’re STILL ranked above every single competitor on trustpilot. Now that’s what I call slay!!

💌 we’ve had over 750,000 new people join our community via ig, tiktok, email etc - nearly half of all our orders were from first time customers lovely enough to try tala for the first time

🤝  that means nearly half of our sales every week were returning customers - this stat means the most to me, because our customer is genuinely our everything, and I can’t tell you how much it means to be able to grow at this pace whilst knowing that our loyal customers keep trusting us over and over for quality & fit

🧥 we launched into FIVE new categories, from linens to 2-in-1 trenches, because versatility & high quality shouldn’t be reserved for your gymwear. this has been a terrifying risk but I’m SO proud of what we’ve been able to do in industries with huge incumbents

I’m so thankful to everyone who’s ever supported us, whether that’s in the last week, or the last 5 years. I can’t thank you enough for being here, BIG things are coming x
hilarious that we live in a world where men complain that the world’s richest women are rich from divorce while not stopping for one second to consider exactly why they built it that way
To my favourite person in the whole wide world.

If you comment “woman” I’ll send you an episode all about what you can do with your health now, that your body and mind will thank you for in a decade (we’re talking bones, hormones, PMOS, sleep, the whole lot)

We’ve reached Episode 4 of the Future Self Series and @drfayebate is taking over the mic!!

I wanted this episode to be specifically designed for ambitious women, and Faye has absolutely delivered. She gets into eating enough to fuel everything you’re doing, understanding your hormones, why you can be exhausted all day and then wide awake in bed, and how to deregulate your nervous system on your busiest days. All with the research to back it up, because you know we like our sources over here.

And I really love that she leaves room for actually enjoying your life in all of this, because i’m a firm believer that a late night with your friends doesn’t need to become something else to feel guilty about!!

The episode is live now. Thank you so much for supporting the podcast during my maternity leave, I hope you love this one!

If you comment ‘move’ I'll send you the link to an episode all about how to make those big life decisions that feel really scary but your future self will thank you for

episode 2 of the Future Self Series with @jemmasbeg taking over the mic!! 

Jemma’s getting into how the decisions we make in our 20s can end up shaping our 30s, 40s and beyond, but, most importantly, without any of the shame that usually comes attached to this conversation (and the toxic narrative about how we need to have done absolutely everything by 30).

We get into why having more options can actually make it harder to choose, why apparently we tend to regret the things we didn’t do more than the things we did, and how to work out what your future self actually wants you to do. And as always, Jemma brings the studies to back everyhting up, so get ready to take notes.

Thank you so much for supporting the podcast during my maternity leave and I hope you love it!

If you comment ‘future’ I’ll send you an episode all about exactly how to go about designing your dream life for yourself. 

We're kicking off the Future Self Series with one of Working Hard's all-time favourite guests! @roxienafousi is back to start us exactly where every plan for your future should, with figuring out what you actually want that future to look like in the first place.

We’re talking reverse engineering your future self, the mindset shifts that need to happen before any plan actually sticks, and a VERY good exercise to help you get there (which I will absolutely be stealing). 

I hope you love it! And thank you for supporting the podcast during my maternity leave 💘

Introducing the Future Self Series! Whilst I’m off figuring out how to use a breast pump, I’ve somehow assembled the world’s most overqualified 12-person maternity cover to help you figure out everything else.

The tiny podcast team & I have spent the last nine months building this behind the scenes, going back through five years of Working Hard data, your favourite episodes, DMs, and emails to create a series across my maternity leave designed to help you reverse engineer the life you actually want. We’re tackling mindset, identity, relationships, career, money, health, habits and everything in between, with some of the most brilliant experts I could possibly hand the mic to. It’s basically a free course disguised as a podcast, which if you've been here a while, you'll know is extremely on brand.

So, starting this Monday, we’re working through it all together for the next 12 weeks, so by the time we head into 2027, you’ll hopefully have a much clearer idea of where you actually want to go AND a practical framework for getting there. 

If you comment 'self' and I'll send you the link to the podcast so you can hit follow and make sure you don't miss an episode! x
